note: Runs overlap and are not additive. Later runs cover final conservative security and public-surface extensions.
limitations: No full repository suite rerun; unrelated Step 3 broad-regression failures are not claimed fixed.
PASS refers to deterministic checks in supported scope, not semantic API equivalence.
Legacy projects without an approved Architecture remain explicitly WARNING/no-baseline until adoption.
Only Native and mini-SWE task engines are supported; other task engines fail closed.
